recs.x:
(define eval-expr
 (lambda (expr env)
 (pmatch expr
 [`,x (guard (symbol? x))
 (env x)]
 [`(lambda (,x) ,body)
 (lambda (arg)
 (eval-expr body (lambda (y)
 (if (eq? x y)
 arg
 (env y)))))]
 [`(,rator ,rand)
 ((eval-expr rator env)
 (eval-expr rand env))])))
